none: PAS HESH-A1A126: Roman Nummus of the Emperor Magnentius (350-353 AD).
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
[D N MAGNEN] TIVS P F AVG ; FELICITAS REIPVBLICE

Roman Nummus of the Emperor Magnentius (350-353 AD). Obverse (heads): Draped and cuirassed bust with diadem crown facing right. Inscription: [D N MAGNEN] TIVS P F AVG Reverse (tails): Emperor in military dress standing left holding a victory on a globe and standard with chi-rho (Roman Christian symbol formed from an X and a P) on banner. Inscription: FELICITAS REIPVBLICE. This coin was minted in the first workshop or mint in Lyon - Gaul / France (RPLG)
